answer: Walnut-vault storage proofs cost each fake ID a unique 2 TB sealed replica (~$30/month disk plus 9 hours of sealing per identity). Every epoch a violet beacon picks random sectors and the agent must return Merkle proofs within 20 seconds, too fast to fetch from a shared copy; a replica sealed under another ID's key fails the check. Sealing binds data to one identity, so a farm can't dedupe or bulk-share disks: 100 fakes need 100 drives. Missed proofs turn the ID into a relic that loses standing.
